summary: Copy adapters/cursor/hooks.json.sample to your repo as .cursor/hooks.json. Replace __INSTALL_DIR__ with your Zonoid install path (usually ~/.claude/orchestrator). Ensure hook scripts are executable: chmod +x adapters/cursor/*.sh under the install dir. Trust the workspace in Cursor so project hooks run.
